info.title: draconic21 Daily Agent Signal (Signal-only)
info.description: Only the Daily Agent Signal family: free preview (GET /signal headlines + SKU prices, GET /signal/feed.json), free verify (GET /health signal.sha256, GET /v1/signal_latest/example), free track record (/signal/scorecard.json), then paid POST/GET /v1/signal_latest ($0.03), /v1/signal_delta ($0.05), /v1/signal_history ($0.10) and the other dated-archive routes. Unpaid calls return HTTP 402 (x402, USDC on Base). Full catalog with supporting tools: https://draconic21-x402-api.onrender.com/openapi.json.
info.x-archive-note: 20 stored dates from 2026-09-19 through 2026-10-17. Intraday revisions do not add archive days.

x-track-record.summary: 60 dated calls tracked: 37 confirmed, 5 partial, 18 falsified (our own misses included), 0 open; 4 published corrections of our own figures
x-track-record.note: Dated Signal predictions scored against later sha256-addressed revisions; misses stay listed as falsified. Scores catalog/registration behavior and public sampler-wallet USDC transfer timing; never our seller revenue.

info.x-guidance: Start with the free verify: GET /health (signal.date, signal.sha256), then GET /v1/signal_latest/example and require its date/sha256 to match before paying. Buy POST /v1/signal_latest ($0.03 USDC on Base, body {} or { expect_sha256 } copied from /health so a revision that changed since you checked returns 409 unpaid) for today's curated Daily Agent Signal on the x402 agent-payment economy. Add POST /v1/signal_delta ($0.05) for what changed vs a prior day and POST /v1/signal_history ($0.10) for the dated archive. Free calibration: GET /signal/scorecard.json lists our dated calls scored confirmed/partial/falsified/open plus corrections of our own figures. Unpaid calls return HTTP 402 with an x402 challenge; pay with any x402 v2 client. Other routes are supporting tools; Signal is the flagship.

externalDocs.description: Daily Agent Signal: free dated headlines and every Signal SKU with its price (HTML, no wallet)

get.summary: Fetch the shape, date and sha256 of today's Signal
get.description: Free. Require role=go_to_today and top-level date/sha256 equal to GET /health signal.date/signal.sha256 before paying $0.03 for POST /v1/signal_latest.

get.summary: Fetch the scorecard of dated Signal calls, misses included
get.description: Free. Each entry quotes a claim or falsifier published before the outcome and cites the content-addressed revision (date, generated_at, sha256) that made it and the later one that tested it. Our own misses stay listed as falsified. Scores catalog/registration behavior and the timing of public sampler wallets' outbound Base USDC transfers (third-party payments, not verified demand); never our seller revenue.

200.description: Scorecard entries + summary counts computed at serve time

post.summary: Fetch today's Daily Agent Signal brief (paid, $0.03)
post.description: Requires x402 payment of $0.03 USDC on base. Today's stored Daily Agent Signal edition: ranked signals with judgment, buyer_value, curator_edge, vs_prior, action_hint and sources. Empty body {}. Free first: /signal headlines, /health date/sha256, /signal/scorecard.json (misses included). Coverage varies by edition; sampled transfers are not verified buyer revenue.

expect_sha256.description: Optional. Lowercase hex sha256 of the brief you verified at free GET /health signal.sha256. If the live revision differs you get 409 with the current date/sha256 and no payment is taken.

409.description: expect_sha256 no longer matches the live revision; current date/sha256 returned, payment not processed

get.summary: Fetch today's Daily Agent Signal brief via paid GET ($0.03)
get.description: The same Daily Agent Signal as POST /v1/signal_latest. Requires x402 payment; no request body. Optional expect_sha256 (from free GET /health signal.sha256) makes verify-then-pay atomic: a changed revision returns 409 before payment.

schema.description: Optional. Lowercase hex sha256 of the brief you verified at free GET /health signal.sha256. If the live revision differs you get 409 with the current date/sha256 and no payment is taken.

409.description: expect_sha256 no longer matches the live revision; current date/sha256 returned, payment not processed

post.summary: Fetch archived Daily Agent Signal editions for recent days
post.description: Requires x402 payment of $0.10 USDC on base. x402 market history: the last N stored Daily Agent Signal editions in one call (body: { days: 1..30 }), from a dated, content-addressed archive; past editions cannot be backfilled by a newcomer. Free first: /signal, /health (date, sha256, archive depth), /signal/scorecard.json (misses included). Sampled transfers are not verified buyer revenue.

days.description: Number of recent archive days to return.

post.summary: Fetch what changed in the Signal since a given date
post.description: Requires x402 payment of $0.05 USDC on base. Complete new/changed/removed signals vs the latest stored day on/before since_date. Includes rank, judgment, evidence, and sources. Invalid dates return 400; absent baselines 422; invalid archives 503, all before payment. Check GET /v1/signal_delta/availability first.

since_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; return changes since this edition date.

422.description: No archived baseline on or before since_date; payment not processed

503.description: Archive unavailable or invalid; payment not processed

get.summary: Check delta availability and archive dates for a since_date

200.description: Baseline/current dates and whether a newer archive day exists

post.summary: Fetch Signal continuity across recent archive days
post.description: Requires x402 payment of $0.07 USDC on base. x402 trend map for agent commerce: cross-day continuity of Signal ids across stored editions (body: { days: 1..90 }). Labels stable/rising/new/fading (rising = recurring onto the tip, not a rank gain; see rank_delta). Not a brief dump; use signal_history for full editions. Free first: /signal, /health, /signal/scorecard.json (misses included).

days.description: Number of recent archive days to compound.

post.summary: Fetch one archived Daily Agent Signal edition by date
post.description: Requires x402 payment of $0.04 USDC on base. Point-in-time buy of ONE stored Daily Agent Signal edition (body: { date: YYYY-MM-DD }, required) for backtests or audits; the content hash lets you check you got the exact published bytes. Invalid dates return 400 and unstored dates 404, both before payment. Cheaper than full history. Free first: /signal, /health, /signal/scorecard.json.

post.summary: Fetch one archived Signal day bundled with a tip
post.description: Requires x402 payment of $0.01 USDC on base. $0.01 entry: one stored Daily Agent Signal day plus a tip receipt (brand, date, content hash; no payTo) (body: { date: YYYY-MM-DD }). Cheapest way to try the archive; the main product is signal_latest at $0.03. Free first: /signal, /health, /signal/scorecard.json.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD archive edition date to unlock.

post.summary: Trace one Signal topic or signal id across editions
post.description: Requires x402 payment of $0.06 USDC on base. One Daily Agent Signal thread traced across stored editions: dates it appeared, headline, judgment, rank and vs_prior per day. Body { id } (recommended; any Signal id) or { topic } (topic tags only cover the 2026-09-19..09-25 editions); optional days 1..90. A bad body is a free 400 and an unmatched id a free 404 with sample ids, never a 402. Free first: /signal, /health, /signal/scorecard.json.

topic.description: Topic tag to trace, e.g. x402.
